story.heading: Where Passion and Flavor Come to Live
story.quote: At Buena Vista, we aim to deliver first-class hospitality and a memorable dining experience. From start to finish, expect exceptional service, delicious food, exotic cocktails, and a carefully curated wine list.

content.positioning: Step into Buena Vista Restaurant & Bar, where bold Spanish-Latin American flavors meet refined New York City dining. From expertly crafted cocktails to shareable plates inspired by Spain and South America, every visit is a vibrant culinary journey designed for connection, celebration, and unforgettable nights out.
